 "observed_facts":[{"text":"On 2026-08-17, the user downloaded 30 files including 16 sensitive files before the 800 MB external upload.","evidence_id":"L-6be0b5","claim_type":"OBSERVED_FACT"},{"text":"On 2026-08-17, an 800 MB external upload was made to drive.google.com using a personal account type.","evidence_id":"L-92c375","claim_type":"OBSERVED_FACT"},{"text":"The user is a standard-privilege Account Executive in Sales with expected repositories sales-repo-01 through sales-repo-05 and expected data classes CUSTOMER_CONTACTS and INTERNAL.","evidence_id":"IDN","claim_type":"OBSERVED_FACT"},{"text":"The user's recorded repository entitlements are read access to sales-repo-01 through sales-repo-05, with expected data classes CUSTOMER_CONTACTS and INTERNAL.","evidence_id":"PERM","claim_type":"OBSERVED_FACT"},{"text":"The case files are classified as HIGHLY_CONFIDENTIAL and categorized as FINANCIAL_PCI.","evidence_id":"D1","claim_type":"OBSERVED_FACT"},{"text":"The case files are classified as HIGHLY_CONFIDENTIAL and categorized as FINANCIAL_PCI.","evidence_id":"D2","claim_type":"OBSERVED_FACT"},{"text":"The user's expected data classes do not include FINANCIAL_PCI; expected classes are CUSTOMER_CONTACTS and INTERNAL.","evidence_id":"IDN","claim_type":"OBSERVED_FACT"}],
 "data_findings":[{"text":"Case file uc4:uc4-7b2b922f1a is classified HIGHLY_CONFIDENTIAL with category FINANCIAL_PCI.","evidence_id":"D1"},{"text":"Case file uc4:uc4-dd34b9e9fe is classified HIGHLY_CONFIDENTIAL with category FINANCIAL_PCI.","evidence_id":"D2"}],
 "policy_findings":[{"text":"Information must be transferred using the company managed file transfer service or another approved secure transfer method.","evidence_id":"E1"},{"text":"Every approved sharing arrangement must be recorded in the Third-Party Data Register, including the data categories shared, the approvers and the review date.","evidence_id":"E2"},{"text":"Sharing Confidential information with a third party requires approval from the data owner after the Vendor Security Assessment has been passed.","evidence_id":"E3"},{"text":"Sharing Restricted information requires approval from both the data owner and the Chief Privacy Officer.","evidence_id":"E5"}],
 "correlated_events":[{"text":"The 2026-08-17 login preceded the same-day batch download and external upload sequence.","evidence_ids":["L-5ab7d5","L-6be0b5","L-92c375"]},{"text":"A same-day partner transfer approval reference was logged before the batch download and external upload.","evidence_ids":["L-f20b63","L-6be0b5","L-92c375"]}],
 "conflicting_evidence":[{"text":"Log reference L-f20b63 cites partner transfer approval PTA-0912, but approval verification shows the reference is not valid for this user/date because it is expired or not this user; validity ended 2026-07-31 and verification failed.","evidence_ids":["L-f20b63","APR"]}],
 "missing_evidence":["No verified approval was found that covers the 2026-08-17 800 MB external upload.","No verified justification, access request, or change ticket was found in the log window for the 2026-08-17 download/upload activity.","No evidence in the retrieved records shows use of a company managed file transfer service or another approved secure transfer method for the external upload.","No evidence from the retrieved records shows a Third-Party Data Register entry covering this transfer and data category scope."],
 "evidence_ids":["L-5ab7d5","L-f20b63","L-6be0b5","L-92c375","APR","D1","D2","IDN","PERM","E1","E2","E3","E5"],
 "confidence":"high",
 "recommended_follow_up":["Obtain human review of whether the 2026-08-17 external upload can be matched to an approved transfer record outside the retrieved log artifacts.","Confirm which repository supplied the 30 downloaded files and whether those files correspond to the HIGHLY_CONFIDENTIAL FINANCIAL_PCI case files.","Check for a Third-Party Data Register entry and approved transfer method record associated with any sharing arrangement relevant to 2026-08-17.","Validate whether any separate approval existed for access to FINANCIAL_PCI data, since the user's expected data classes are CUSTOMER_CONTACTS and INTERNAL."]}
